subrepos.name: renquant-common
subrepos.role: shared primitives + contracts + shared TRAINING/EVAL utilities (Task/Job/Pipeline, purged_cv, walk_forward_splits, hmm_regime_labels, config_consistency) — imported by the model factory & pipeline

subrepos.name: renquant-strategy-104
subrepos.role: active 104 strategy config; CONSUMES models from renquant-artifacts

subrepos.name: renquant-model
subrepos.role: MODEL FACTORY — ingests base-data + common code, runs research/training (GBDT + PatchTST families), and produces models published to renquant-artifacts

subrepos.name: renquant-pipeline
subrepos.role: runtime inference/decision pipeline; shares regime/config code with trainers

subrepos.name: renquant-backtesting
subrepos.role: backtesting, LEAN assembly, simulation, forensics; CONSUMES models from renquant-artifacts

subrepos.name: renquant-base-data
subrepos.role: base-data manifests + the training-data INPUT consumed by the model factory

subrepos.name: renquant-artifacts
subrepos.role: artifact registry — RECEIVES trained models from the factory; consumed by sim/backtest/strategy-104

subrepos.name: renquant-orchestrator
subrepos.role: pinned-subrepo daily orchestration + run bundles (wires factory output into daily/sim/backtest)
